# Spiritual Translation of the Chapter

** ¶1:** His followers ask him: Did spiritual death — the reign of evil and falsity in the natural mind — arise and establish itself as a governing principle? Or did it turn in ward upon its own doc trinal def enses, completing the corruption of both the will and the understanding?

**¶2:** It stir red what was lat ent, and those things dwelling in the natural mind given over to falsity were moved in the first degree of corruption .

**¶3:** Yet after a long interval , when no resistance remained, there was an influx from below: the five perv erted capac ities of spiritual death sur ged up ward — obsc urity of thought born of falsity, self-love, false reasoning proce eding from evil, fals ified truth, and the complete absence of wisdom . In a second degree of establishment, these were fixed into permanent states — interior forms in which spiritual death took up its dwelling .

**¶4:** The fourth degree is the evil works produced within the five per ceptions of the sens ory mind, each ro oted in one of the five states of the natural man ruled by falsity.

**¶ 5:** In the fifth degree, spiritual death extended its dominion into every derivative affection and thought existing across those five states — all that had been formed and generated from the evil works of spiritual death. These are the five states of the proprium, the five orders of self -derived life in which spiritual death is established. It divided itself into ten powers : five corru ptions of the understanding and five corruptions of the will.

** ¶6:** Now, just as the natural mind given over to falsity nourished its five perv erted capacities through its own anim ating spirit , so likewise the ten corru ptions of understanding and will — through the self -love and concupiscence of the proprium — are y oked together, the corru pted will con joined to the corrupted understanding, and the corrupted understanding to the corrupted will, so that they were arr ayed in complete opposition to the Divine Human. This is the final state of the realm of fals ity: it stands condemned in perpetu ity.

**¶7:** Together with the mystery of these twelve powers of opposition that arose within the realm of falsity and were set against the Divine Human — these are the twelve spirits of error, falsities in their complete full ness, each one a perversion of a genuine state of spiritual life, as the twelve signs of the heav enly circle represent the whole order of faith and charity through which the Divine flows into the human mind. Every such state has its inf ernal count erf eit, and these twelve counter feits constitute the tot ality of what opp oses regener ation.

---

*A note on method : * The " five elements " consistently correspond to the five capac ities of the sens ory- natural degree — the ou termost mind through which all infl ux must pass. Their du plication into male and female ( understanding and will) and their multiplication into twelve follows the ancient pattern of showing how a single root evil differ entiates into the complete system of spiritual opposition . The zod iac al image in ¶7 res ists simple one -to-one translation; I have rendered it as the complete cycle of genuine spiritual states, each of which generates , by in version, its own opposing fals ity.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [In the first time] it moved it and [aroused] they that are in the [depths] of the earth of darkness [. This is the] first part.

Yet, after a long time, as there was not [any resistance remaining], it gushed and streamed up [from below. These are] the five elements of Death that gushed [upward,] which are smoke, fire, wind, water and darkness[. In] the second time [of its establishment] they were sculpted [into enduring forms,] those in which Death was established [and dwelt].
The fourth part is the evil fruits [that were brought forth] in the five trees that are in the five worlds of the land of darkness.

The fifth time it spread itself out to its creatures that exist in the five worlds; the ones that were formed and generated from the five fruits of Death. They are the five worlds of flesh, the five creations of darkness in which Death has been established. It spread itself out to ten parts, five male parts and five female [parts].

Now, like the land of darkness, in that its spirit and its [soul] they nourished the five elements [of Death]; this is also [how] the ten parts that are in male and female, the fire and lust of the flesh [stir] them, as they yoke them with one another [, male with female and female with male, until] they were established against the First Man. This is [the final condemnation] of the darkness, it was condemned for ever.

Alongside the mystery of these twelve parts that came about in the darkness [and were arrayed] against the First Man. The twelve [are] the twelve spirits of error that came about from the twelve signs of the zodiac [, each one a counterfeit of a true power of the heavens, and together they constitute the totality of opposition].

Did Death arise and stand firm [from below] up? Or else did it turn itself from [within upon] its armour [, enc losing itself] in its [own realm,] but it finished [the corruption of] the two [natures ].
